generations.description: The original Skyline GT-R, legendary in Japanese motorsport. Featured inline-6 engine and established GT-R as Nissan's ultimate performance car.
Short-lived second generation due to fuel crisis. Featured updated styling and continued the GT-R legacy before hiatus.
The Godzilla - dominated Group A racing. Featured RB26DETT twin-turbo engine and ATTESA all-wheel drive. Iconic in tuning culture and motorsport history.
Larger and more refined GT-R. Featured improved RB26DETT engine and handling. Set Nürburgring record. Some enthusiasts prefer R32 or R34.
The ultimate Skyline GT-R. Featured refined RB26DETT engine, advanced technology, and aggressive styling. Highly collectible and iconic in car culture.
Modern GT-R with VR38DETT twin-turbo V6. Produces up to 600+ horsepower. Advanced all-wheel drive and technology. Set multiple production car lap records worldwide.
Nissan's modern Z car revival. Featured VQ35DE V6 engine producing up to 306 horsepower. Excellent handling and became popular among enthusiasts for its balance of performance and affordability.
Refined Z car with VQ37VHR engine producing 332 horsepower. Improved handling and technology. Nismo variant offered track-focused performance. Long production run showed its popularity.
Latest Z car with twin-turbo V6 engine producing 400 horsepower. Modern technology while honoring Z car heritage. Performance and Nismo variants available.
Nissan's rear-wheel-drive sports coupe. Featured KA24E/DE engines and became legendary in drifting culture. Popular platform for engine swaps, especially SR20DET.
Refined 240SX with improved styling. Featured updated KA24DE engine. Continued popularity in drifting and tuning scenes. Highly sought after for modification projects.

Final S-chassis Silvia. Sold in Japan and select markets as the Silvia S15; not officially marketed in the US as 240SX. Featured SR20DET engine, sharp styling, and advanced suspension. Highly sought after in US import scene and drift culture.
1st US Altima. KA24DE.
Nissan's mid-size sedan with V6 engine option. Featured updated styling and improved technology. SE-R trim offered sportier character.
Larger platform with improved interior space. Featured updated V6 engines and improved fuel economy. Continued Altima's reputation for value and performance.
Complete redesign with more modern styling. Featured updated engines and introduced hybrid option. Improved technology and safety features.
Latest generation with turbocharged engine option. Improved technology, safety, and fuel economy. AWD option available. More refined and competitive in mid-size segment.
B13 Sentra. SE-R (SR20DE).
B14 Sentra. SE-R + 200SX twin.
Nissan's compact sedan with efficient engines. Featured updated styling and became popular for its value and reliability.
Larger platform with improved interior space. Featured updated engines and improved fuel economy. SE-R trim offered sportier character.
Complete redesign with more modern styling. Featured updated engines and improved technology. Focus on fuel economy and value.
Latest generation with improved technology and safety features. Featured updated engines and continued Sentra's focus on value and efficiency.

Nissan's compact crossover with turbocharged 1.6L engine producing 188 hp. Unique styling with round headlights on the hood. AWD available. Popular for intake upgrades, exhaust modifications, ECU tuning, and suspension work.
Second-generation Juke with updated styling and turbocharged 1.0L three-cylinder engine. Improved interior quality and technology. European market focus.
Nissan Maxima full-size front-wheel-drive sedan with 3.0L VQ30DE V6 producing 222 hp. Popular for exhaust upgrades and performance modifications.
Sixth-generation Maxima with 3.5L VQ35DE V6 producing 265 hp. Sporty sedan with sport-tuned suspension option. Popular for exhaust, intake, and suspension modifications.
Seventh-generation Maxima with 3.5L VQ35DE V6 producing 290 hp. CVT standard. Upscale full-size sedan with sport package available.
Eighth-generation Maxima '4-Door Sports Car' with bold styling and 3.5L VQ35DE V6 producing 300 hp. Popular for exhaust upgrades, wheels, and cosmetic modifications.
Third-gen Fairlady Z; VG30E/VG30ET engines. Popular for engine swaps and turbo rebuilds.
Twin-turbo VG30DETT 300 hp flagship. Strong aftermarket for exhaust, intake, suspension.
Skyline R32 GTS/GTS-T (HCR32/HR32). RB20DET turbo. Shares platform with GT-R BNR32.
Skyline R33 GTS/GTS-T (ECR33). RB25DET turbo JDM sedan/coupe.
Skyline R34 25GT-T (ER34). RB25DET NEO-6 turbo.
